terminal_record.title: Unverified claim of FBI investigations into Milley, Esper and Romney
terminal_record.description_short: The supplied record alleges April 2025 FBI investigations of Milley, Esper and Romney; its AP link gives background on Patel, not confirmation.
terminal_record.description_medium: The frozen record alleges that FBI Director Kash Patel opened investigations in April 2025 into retired General Mark Milley, former Defense Secretary Mark Esper and Senator Mitt Romney as political adversaries. The packet gives no case records, agency statement or reporting confirming those investigations. Its Associated Press link describes Patel’s prior criticism of the FBI and support for Trump, but does not document inquiries into the three named people. This remains unverified.
terminal_record.description_long: The frozen record alleges that, in April 2025, the FBI under Kash Patel opened investigations into Mark Milley, Mark Esper and Mitt Romney because they were perceived as political adversaries of Donald Trump. It says Milley and Esper had criticized Trump after leaving government and that Romney voted against Trump in both impeachment trials; the supplied packet provides no citations for the alleged investigations or their motive. Associated Press coverage dated January 30, 2025, characterized Patel as a staunch Trump defender and critic of the FBI while he was the nominee to lead the bureau. That background does not establish that he opened investigations into Milley, Esper or Romney, nor does it verify a shared target list or retaliatory purpose. Keep April 1 only as the supplied, unconfirmed start date. The alleged investigation, its subjects and the claim of political vengeance all require separate evidence before publication. This internal draft preserves the claim for review and does not represent it as a finding, charge, or confirmed FBI action.
